newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends unchanged in rangebound trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends unchanged in rangebound trade.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended unchanged on Monday at 35.715/725 per dollar in tight range-bound trade, dealers said.
"There was hardly any movement today with trade restricted to a range between 35.715 and 35.725," a dealer at a foreign bank said. "Supply and demand were well matched."

The Reserve Bank of India bought dollars at 35.72 rupees, a dealer said. Premia on forward dollars were steady for most of the day, before easing towards the close, dealers said. The premia for six-month dollars ended at 9.85 percent against the weekend close of 9.97, they said.
